sentences.libimf: libimf math functions provided by a host callback to the original build's runtime

extra.task: D193 one model day, assembled coupled step

installed.clouds_mstcnv_jax.jnp: libimf_ops.JnpProxy (power, exp -> libimf_ops; everything else jax.numpy)
installed.jax_p1_glue.jnp: libimf_ops.JnpProxy (matopmb pk pow, pek_of pow, calc_trop pow x2)

stage_table.name: record_load
stage_table.description: host file reads of the recorded entry data of the step through the registry, then device_put (CONDSE entry set, radiation record, restart ice state)

stage_table.name: dyn
stage_table.description: DYNAM+QDYNAM+energy fix+TROP+PGRAD_PBL+KEA, all kernels and glue on device; NumPy part: none; host part: dispatch of ~100 kernel calls from Python, QDYNAM extra-column branch not executed (flagged) [libimf pow/exp: labelled host callback inside this stage, time included]

stage_table.name: condse_entry
stage_table.description: CONDSE entry set

stage_table.name: condse_setup
stage_table.description: CONDSE column set-up (JJ) + south pole column: per-column NumPy port clouds_condse_ff.condse_column through pure_callback (NP) [libimf pow/exp: labelled host callback inside this stage, time included]

stage_table.name: condse_mstcnv
stage_table.description: MSTCNV (D189): cloud-base loop and event block as ONE device program; libimf exp/pow through FUSED host callbacks (C shim over libimf.so); QUS ADV1D subsidence = NumPy host callback (176 calls)

stage_table.name: condse_post
stage_table.description: CONDSE post-processing + LSCOND (JJ); north pole column through pure_callback (NP) [libimf pow/exp: labelled host callback inside this stage, time included]

stage_table.name: radia
stage_table.description: RADIA apply: hand-off interface of D185; in replay mode the packet is served from the recorded ffa_step_r record (REC); with the real server FORT

stage_table.name: flag_read
stage_table.description: one host read of the stop-model flags per step

stage_table.name: template_build
stage_table.description: host: scatter of the recorded SURFACE rows (ffp/ffs/ffl/ffg/fft) into the fixed slots, per-cell Python GHY batch build (ghy_advnc_test.build_batch), upload of the template (D188 jax_surface.build_template). Disappears only when Ent and the template columns come from the pytree

stage_table.name: melt_si_dev
stage_table.description: MELT_SI on the device state (jit) and replacement of the CONDSE-entry RSI by its result

stage_table.name: carry_writeback
stage_table.description: CONDSE exit -> carry (CLDSS/CLDMC masking, held SNOAGE/RQT/KLIQ of the radiation server written back into the carry; one small jit)

stage_table.name: tile_mask_check
stage_table.description: tile masks from the MELT_SI result (jax_state_d181.tile_masks), compared with the template slot validity on the device

stage_table.name: surface_pre
stage_table.description: PRECIP_SI, AG2OG, PRECIP_OC (+TOC2SST), PRECIP_LI, PRECIP_LK, seaice_to_atmgrid (jax_posttile.surface_pre_dev)

stage_table.name: nit_rebuild
stage_table.description: host (D195, ON by default, Coupled(nit_fix=True)): only on steps with a cell of recorded ffnit > 11: ONE declared device->host read of PREC/EPREC/PRECSS (3 small arrays), ghy_advnc_test.build_batch (NumPy, ghy_ref_nit.run_cell_full) of those rows with OUR precipitation, device replacement of edts/ecnc/elai/ebet/nsub/dt of those cells (jax_surface.nit_rebuild); a no-op, no transfer, on the other steps

stage_table.name: template_apply
stage_table.description: device rewrite of the state columns of the SURFACE templates and of the GHY precipitation forcing (jax_tpl_state)

stage_table.name: surface_tiles_land
stage_table.description: SURFACE stage (D188): PBL, tile fluxes, aggregation, ATURB, land GHY (Ent exports, land forcing and tile radiation columns are RECORDED inputs), land ice, 2 substeps; 5 jit executions

stage_table.name: tile_acc
stage_table.description: tile accumulators of the post-tile stage from the device tile outputs

stage_table.name: post_a
stage_table.description: DYNSI, GROUND_LI, lake chain, RIVERF, ocean-driver head (jit)

stage_table.name: ocean_a
stage_table.description: OCEANS: ground, ostres, oconv, drag, polar (jit)

stage_table.name: ocean_b
stage_table.description: OCEANS: dynamics, straits, post, odiff, meso (jit) with the OADVT2 X pre-pass as a host pure_callback (4 calls/step, NumPy)

stage_table.name: post_b
stage_table.description: FORM_SI, TOC2SST, ADVSI (double-double Ti2b), pole replication (jit)

stage_table.name: dissip_filter
stage_table.description: DISSIP + FILTER (J3, jax_phase2); the pow of SLP, MAtoPMB and PEK through the libimf host callback

stage_table.name: state_assembly
stage_table.description: assembly of the next-step state pytree (device dict operations, no jit)
